# Zanove Technologies

> Zanove Technologies is a Nigeria-first digital studio helping businesses improve their digital presence and build useful products and connected systems.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://zanove-technologies.vercel.app/): Digital products, websites and business systems.
- [Services](https://zanove-technologies.vercel.app/service.html): Website and software development, digital products, AI creative, automation and growth.
- [Projects](https://zanove-technologies.vercel.app/projects.html): Selected product, web, AI and creative work.
- [About](https://zanove-technologies.vercel.app/about.html): Zanove Technologies and its approach.
- [Website audit](https://zanove-technologies.vercel.app/audit.html): First-pass public website review and project contact path.
- [Books](https://zanove-technologies.vercel.app/ebook.html): Books by Vera, with links to their Selar listings.
- [Journal](https://zanove-technologies.vercel.app/blog.html): Practical writing on websites, AI and digital growth.
- [Ask Zanove AI](https://zanove-technologies.vercel.app/ask-ai.html): AI assistant for questions about Zanove's services and work.

- [Project consultation](https://zanove-technologies.vercel.app/project.html): Request a consultation about a website, product, software or workflow.
